findings.title: Advisory Direct registration failures block committed reads
findings.trigger: No journal/candidate; readable committed DB/manifest, writable preexisting writer lock and readable preexisting family/resource guards; registration is either corrupt or absent while its parent is chmod555.
findings.mechanism: begin_read propagates register_direct_pair parse/create errors before admission. resolve_direct_read propagates this into runtime resolution.
findings.consequence: Existing graph queries/health lose access because optional future-cleanup overlap metadata is unavailable.
findings.baseline: All three isolated probes pass; registration metadata is not a committed-read prerequisite.
findings.reviewed: Writable first read passes; corrupt registration fails JSON parse; readonly missing-registration fails EACCES. DB/manifest bytes preserved.
findings.remedy: Retain real writer/resource guards and mandatory ambiguous publication replay; preserve/report failed overlap registration as unknown maintenance instead of failing a committed read. Ensure collection never treats failed registration as proven idle or overwrite corrupt evidence.
findings.verification: Promote the three isolated admission probes into regressions; verify runtime resolution still reads a real graph and maintenance stays unknown/pending for invalid or unwritable registration.

limitations: Only deterministic local storage admission probes were executed by this reviewer; native DB bytes were synthetic because failure occurs before opening/inspecting native contents. Reachability into runtime resolution established statically.
